extensionPolicy: If capacity permits add wholly new families101-200 with the identical within-block split/count design; never change core500 IDs/splits. No existing Test conversations or descendants are generation inputs.
foldPolicy: Train families assigned stable fold0..4; every pair/variant within sourceGroup stays in fold. Independently authored scenes must not be superficial noun-swapped templates.
annotationPolicy: Primary judge is a different subagent, receives only opaque id, agenda, phase, transcript, common rubric. Actual labels need not match design intent.
freezePolicy: Family assignments and design targets frozen before bulk text authoring; content/labels frozen versioned after annotation and audits. Never relabel to reach80%.
